name: Sugahara Touka
source:
The main protagonist of "Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia Concerto 2"

A mysterious girl who is always alone. She appears to be the cool type and doesn't say much.

She has a younger sister, whom she cherishes more than anything else.

She didn't have much confidence in herself, but through her fight with Haruno, she has had more opportunities to show her true compassion.

[Translated from [url=https://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/exs-tia_conce/finale/]Official Site[/url]]
